text:
aisha_support: Customer BrightBank opened a ticket — invoice INV-9921 attempted to charge immediately and card declined. They attached a screenshot from the portal showing PO BB-778 with 'Require payment upfront' toggled on. They say they selected Net 30 in procurement, but their procurement system also sets a PO-level prepay flag. Can billing confirm whether our flow honors the PO prepay flag or if this was a race?
ben_finance: Looking at INV-9921 — there is a charge attempt at 2026-03-10T14:12:03Z, decline code 041. Invoice metadata shows net_terms=30 and prepay=false. Customer claim that portal shows 'upfront required' could mean our sync from procurement lost a flag.
priya_csm: Customer sent a screenshot showing the portal toggle ON and a support note that their procurement requires prepay. They're asking for provisional credit and a clear ETA. They flagged this as P1 for their compliance team.
tom_billing: I ran a quick repro in staging: when PO sync payload contains metadata.prepay=true we should set invoice.prepay=true and block auto-charge. There's an active regression where webhook retries dropped metadata.prepay during a 500 -> 502 cascade in payment-sync last week. Will pull logs.
ben_finance: If webhook lost the prepay flag, that explains the auto-attempt. Can you confirm whether marking invoice on_hold will prevent retries and whether we can reissue terms without charging card?
tom_billing: Marking invoice state=on_hold prevents billing daemon from retrying. Plan: 1) re-run procurement->billing sync for account brightbank (backfill metadata), 2) set invoice INV-9921 to on_hold, 3) if prepay=true after backfill we cancel the charge and create a new invoice with upfront requirement. For the attempted charge that failed, we can issue a provisional credit while we reissue paperwork.
priya_csm: Customer wants provisional credit until it's resolved. They also asked for the exact repro steps so their procurement team can audit. Can you paste the logs / command you used, tom?
tom_billing: Repro steps I used (staging):
```
# simulate procurement webhook payload
curl -X POST https://staging.billing.internal/hooks/procurement \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"po_id":"BB-778","metadata":{"prepay":true,"external_flow":"coupa"},"account_id":"acct_BRIGHT"}'
# run sync job
./scripts/sync_procurement_to_billing --account acct_BRIGHT --dry-run=false
# observe invoice state changes in DB
select id, state, metadata ->> 'prepay' as prepay from invoices where id='INV-9921';
```
Logs show `payment-sync` returned 500 at 2026-03-09T22:05:12Z and webhook retry logic dropped `metadata` on the second retry due to a marshal bug.
elaine_ops: I approve provisional credit up to $5,000 for customer goodwill while engineering fixes the backfill. Please add AR note and escalate to legal if necessary. :white_check_mark:
payments_bot: AUTO: charge_attempt_failed INV-9921 code=041 reason="insufficient_funds" metadata={"card_last4":"4242"}
ben_finance: Thanks. Once invoice is on_hold and sync re-runs, confirm whether we need to issue a credit memo or reverse the gateway event. For bookkeeping we prefer a credit memo linked to INV-9921.
tom_billing: Will create credit_memo CM-314 linked to INV-9921 and add a comment. I'll run re-sync now, then follow up with a consolidated timeline + PR for the webhook marshal fix. ETA for hotfix: 3 hours, then a backfill job overnight.
priya_csm: Perfect. I'll tell the customer we've issued provisional credit (CM-314), placed invoice on_hold, and are doing a backfill with ETA ~overnight. Will share repro steps and ask them to hold any manual payments until we confirm. Thanks all.
aisha_support: Updating support ticket with CM-314, invoice on_hold, and engineering notes. I'll ping when the hotfix deploys. :pray:
